services_status.description: Scans GCP resources for security misconfigurations and compliance violations.
services_status.target_capability_mapping: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) & Custom Configuration Rules

services_status.description: Crawls and analyzes public App Engine, GKE, and Compute Engine web endpoints for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Analyzes Cloud Audit logs, VPC Flow logs, and DNS queries for malicious behavior and compromised identities.
services_status.target_capability_mapping: Cloud Detection & Response (CDR) & Event Stream Analysis

services_status.description: Detects runtime container execution anomalies, suspicious binaries, reverse shells, and malicious kernel calls in GKE.
services_status.target_capability_mapping: Runtime Workload Sensor & K8s Admission Control

services_status.description: Agentless hypervisor-level memory scanning to detect kernel rootkits and crypto-mining on Compute Engine instances.
services_status.target_capability_mapping: Agentless VM Scanning & Runtime Behavioral Detection

services_status.description: Monitors runtime executions in Cloud Run serverless container instances for suspicious binary activity.
Scans public-facing workloads and infrastructure for zero-day vulnerabilities, OS CVEs, and critical flaws.
Detects security vulnerabilities and credential exposures across Vertex AI Workbench notebook instances.
Scans container images stored in Artifact Registry / Container Registry for OS package vulnerabilities.
Continuously audits workloads against CIS, NIST 800-53, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 frameworks.
Provides runtime guardrails and prompt injection defenses for LLMs and AI workloads.
Discovers publicly exposed cloud assets, dangling DNS records, and shadow cloud resources.
Automated discovery and classification of sensitive data in Cloud Storage, BigQuery, and Cloud SQL.
Detects anomalous account activities, abnormal provisioning spikes, and compromised IAM identities.
